title: Page Response Board cards and fetch immutable snapshot bodies on demand
outcome: A board tab remains usable at its allowed card quotas without constructing or transmitting all snapshot bodies at once.
acceptance: Tab view, staging and board mutation responses use bounded card metadata/pages with stable continuation and immutable snapshot body retrieval; limits are applied before loading all bodies.
All allowed placed and staged cards remain navigable and retrievable; omissions are explicit and do not delete or rewrite immutable snapshots.
Client tab/staging selection and rendering work across pages and large bodies; encoded-byte budgets include escaping and envelope.
Tests cover existing maximum-card logic with small injected budgets, continuation and immutable retrieval; independent review and full gate pass.
